content.bridge_context: Exploring how light interacts with objects to create what we see.

units.title: Propagation of Light
units.explanation: Light travels in a straight line (Rectilinear propagation).
units.dual_language_instruction: Can you see around a corner using a straight pipe? / क्या आप सीधे पाइप का उपयोग करके कोने के आसपास देख सकते हैं?

units.title: Reflection
units.explanation: Bouncing back of light after hitting a shiny surface (like a mirror).
units.dual_language_instruction: Look in a mirror. What do you see? / दर्पण में देखें। आप क्या देखते हैं?
